strings.name: Nicole Kidman
strings.summary: Nicole Kidman moved from Australian cinema into international film and television. Moulin Rouge!, The Hours and Big Little Lies show her range in portraying women. Alongside Oscar and Emmy recognition, she co-founded Blossom Films with Per Saari, producing stories led by women for major platforms.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Her films including The Hours and television work have cross-platform influence; producing expands the development of stories about women.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Honolulu, Hawaii, United States; raised in Sydney, Australia
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Film and television recognition
strings.highlights.h1.text: Won the acting Oscar for The Hours and acting and producing Emmys for Big Little Lies.
strings.highlights.h2.title: A role in production
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded Blossom Films with Per Saari in 2010.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Women In Motion honor
strings.timeline.t1.text: Received the 2025 award; Julianne Moore was the 2026 recipient.
strings.timeline.t2.title: AFI honor and Venice acting prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Received AFI’s Life Achievement Award and Venice’s best-actress prize for Babygirl.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Big Little Lies
strings.timeline.t3.text: Starred and produced, winning acting and limited-series Emmys.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Blossom Films founded
strings.timeline.t4.text: Began the production partnership with Per Saari; Rabbit Hole was an early project.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Oscar for The Hours
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won best actress for playing Virginia Woolf in the 2002 film.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Moulin Rouge!
strings.timeline.t6.text: Starred in Baz Luhrmann’s musical film.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Dead Calm
strings.timeline.t7.text: Her performance in the Australian thriller attracted international attention.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Film beginnings
strings.timeline.t8.text: Appeared in the Australian film Bush Christmas at sixteen.
